# hetznerrobot_server_addon_products (Data Source)

Lists the addons — additional IPs, subnets, failover subnets — that `hetznerrobot_server_addon_order` can order for a server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_server_addon_products" "web" {
  server_number = 321
}

output "addon_ids" {
  value = data.hetznerrobot_server_addon_products.web.products[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_number` (Number) Server to list the addons for.

### Read-Only

- `products` (Attributes List) The addon products. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products))

<a id="nestedatt--products"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Addon product id, e.g. `additional_ipv4`.
- `name` (String) Addon name.
- `price` (Attributes) Price of the addon in the server's location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products--price))
- `type` (String) Addon type, e.g. `ip_ipv4`, `subnet_ipv4` or `failover_subnet_ipv4`.

<a id="nestedatt--products--price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products.price`

Read-Only:

- `hourly_gross` (String) Hourly price with VAT; null when the product is not billed hourly.
- `hourly_net` (String) Hourly price without VAT; null when the product is not billed hourly.
- `location` (String) Location the price applies to.
- `monthly_gross` (String) Monthly price with VAT.
- `monthly_net` (String) Monthly price without VAT.
- `setup_gross` (String) One-time setup fee with VAT.
- `setup_net` (String) One-time setup fee without VAT.
